raw: Agent Name: DataExtraction_Expert Step Number: 4 Reason for Mistake: The error occurred when the DataExtraction_Expert used the `count_images_in_wikipedia_article` function to count the `` tags in the HTML content of the Wikipedia article. This approach led to an overestimation of the number of images because it counted all image tags, including those not relevant to the actual content of the article. Wikipedia pages often contain additional `` tags for icons, navigation, and other purposes beyond article content. Thus, the count of 28 images includes more than just the images pertinent to the article. The correct number was 13, so the method used inflated the count by including non-content images.
